supportingSources.label: Kineticist Excalibur rules and machine record

strategy.summary: Knock down all four targets for each required lit color, shoot the center ramp to lock a ball, and plunge the replacement ball to start two-ball Multiball. During Multiball, repeat the center ramp; afterward, hit whichever drop target is flashing before its timer ends for Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Required target colors
quickInfo.summary: The first Multiball requires all four targets in one lit color. Each later start adds another required color until all four colors are needed.

quickInfo.name: Skill plunge
quickInfo.summary: Time the plunge to choose the first required color. The orange upper targets are commonly preferred because they are easier and return more safely than red.

quickInfo.name: Two-ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Knock down all four targets for each required lit color, shoot the center ramp to lock, then plunge the replacement ball to begin two-ball play.

quickInfo.name: Center ramp
quickInfo.summary: During Multiball, the ramp scores 100,000 and advances the Shield bonus multiplier.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Drop-target hits raise the Jackpot value. After Multiball, hit whichever drop target is flashing before the timer ends to collect it.

steps.text: Time the plunge so orange lights first; the orange upper targets are usually safer than the red upper targets or the lower target banks.
Knock down all four targets for each required lit color. Later Multiballs require additional colors.
Shoot the center ramp to lock one ball.
Plunge the replacement ball to start two-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, shoot the center ramp for 100,000 points and to advance the Shield bonus multiplier.
After Multiball ends, watch the drop targets and hit whichever target is flashing before the timer expires to collect Jackpot.
Knock down all four targets for each required lit color.
Drop-target hits raise the Jackpot value.
Start two-ball Multiball at the center ramp.
Shoot the center ramp or knock down all four targets of one color during Multiball to raise the Shield bonus multiplier.
After Multiball, hit whichever drop target is flashing to collect Jackpot.

cautions.issue: A rejected center-ramp shot can drain between the flippers.
cautions.response: Shoot the ramp only from control and stop after a dangerous reject.

cautions.issue: The rubbers above the lower flippers do not kick the ball like slingshots.
cautions.response: Read their first rebounds before relying on them to send the ball away from an outlane.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Gottlieb Excalibur from 1988, ball count, Extra Ball or Special conversion, and Jackpot timer.
Test the center-ramp reject, upper-playfield exits, passive-rubber rebounds, and all four target banks.
strategy.simpleOverview: Excalibur assigns one or more colors to four-target sets. Completing every required color lights a center-ramp lock; the replacement plunge starts two-ball Multiball, and the drop targets build a Jackpot collected only after Multiball ends.
strategy.overview: Completing every required four-target color in Excalibur lights the center-ramp lock. Lock one ball and plunge to start two-ball Multiball. During Multiball, the center ramp scores 100,000 and advances the Shield bonus multiplier; afterward, hit the flashing drop target before the Jackpot timer expires.
machineSetup: Confirm Gottlieb Excalibur from 1988, ball count, Extra Ball or Special conversion, and Jackpot timer.
Test the center-ramp reject, upper-playfield exits, passive-rubber rebounds, and all four target banks.
